fix(widget): P1-A/P1-B trust-boundary hardening in 0.1.07

P1-A: Remove setVerifiedProjectArchive from manualArchiveRecordSent.
A Send receipt proves transmission only; it must not overwrite
Bridge-confirmed canonical archive metadata. The receipt now calls
recordSendObservation (SEND timestamp only) and schedules a bounded
background refreshProjectArchiveMetadata that can adopt canonical
metadata only via Bridge confirmation. Zero canonical-store writes
from the receipt itself.

P1-B: Attach tile-removal detection for attachment-only Send intents.
A rejected attachment-only Send + manual attachment removal + delayed
history must not fabricate an accepted Send timestamp. Added
noteComposerAttachmentRemoved with capture-phase click/keydown
listeners on document detecting operator interaction with Remove
controls inside the composer root. Extended
retireStaleManualSendIntent to check tile count changes for
attachment-only intents (empty composerText), covering React remount
where no click/keydown event fires.

Tests: 21 new RED tests in w7-016 (C1-C10 P1-A, D1-D11 P1-B),
all proven RED pre-fix and GREEN post-fix. Full widget suite 772/772
PASS. Targeted regression gates pass: w6-006 85/85, w6-001 50/50,
w3-002 14/14, w7-011 7/7, test_bridge_project_archive.py 30/30.

Release 0.1.07, sha 5efa3a49fee7bdef83f63ecfa3324e2746eb12b874baad4e1bba03edd03a09fa.
Evidence: .saipen/evidence/T-299-widget-trust-boundary-p1a-p1b.md
EOF
)"
